source_data: fig_paper_layered.py -> fig_state_anatomy - recovered policy vs target at each of the twelve (layer, state) cells [design option 1], plus the per-cell TV the gap integrates over. Off-policy, n_mc=1, MDP 0.

env.transitions: depend on the action only; s'=a w.p. 1-eps, else uniform over the rest

config.start: uniform over the three layer-0 states
config.pi_ref: uniform at every state (t05 overrides this with a peaked reference)
config.oracle: Bradley-Terry on gamma-discounted trajectory return differences, temperature 1
config.runs: 100 independently drawn MDPs, one training seed each
config.weight: calibrated per (regularizer, target peak) by bisection, not a fixed beta
